Immersive Shane Override.Description: Allows this mod's Winter Star dialogue keys to override Immersive Shane's dating/married Winter Star keys. Does nothing without a corresponding selection in the next option.

IC-Shane Conditional Overrides.AllowValues: none, dating only, married only, dating and married
IC-Shane Conditional Overrides.Description: Chooses which of Immersive Shane's dialogues to override (in case of only wanting a conditional override). Defaults to none to prevent overriding. (Immersive Shane does not have default keys to override, and engaged/divorced keys will override this mod.)

Enable Spicy Dialogue.Description: Enables somewhat spicier dialogue from relevant spouses. Will not do anything without corresponding enabled options below, and will not override platonic/asexual PPAF dialogue patches.

In-Law Dialogue.Description: Adds extra dialogue for relatives of your spouses! Set to disabled if you'd prefer that the dialogues do not mention your spouse and just focus on the character in question.

Bonus Penny.Description: Edits the first community upgrade event to add a flag to allow for a different Penny dialogue during the Winter Star after it. This will do nothing if dating or married to Penny, as her dating or marriage version will override this, but it will affect her default dialogue and if you are 9 or 10 hearts without dating her (e.g. with Platonic Relationships or PPAF).

CustomGifts.Description: Adds unique gifts for everyone in the gift pool at the Winter Star, with slight dialogue alterations depending on a villager's gift pool. This option will do nothing with Solstice installed to prevent overriding.

Sandy.Description: Allows Sandy to attend the Winter Star, with placement defaulting to known mod locations (and added if not). Festival dialogue will not be added without the relevant option, but gifting/receiving dialogue will always be added if enabled.

Wizard.Description: Allows the Wizard to attend the Winter Star, with placement defaulting to known mod locations (and added if not).

Krobus.Description: Allows Krobus to attend the Winter Star (in disguise), with placement defaulting to known mod locations (and added if not). Festival dialogue will not be added without the relevant option, but gifting/receiving dialogue will always be added if enabled.

Dwarf.Description: Allows the Dwarf to attend the Winter Star, with placement defaulting to known mod locations (and added if not). Festival dialogue will not be added without the relevant option, but gifting/receiving dialogue will always be added if enabled.
